bioconda.name: bioconductor-turbonorm
bioconda.summary: A fast scatterplot smoother suitable for microarray normalization

biotools.summary: A fast scatterplot smoother based on B-splines with second-order difference penalty. Functions for microarray normalization of single-colour data i.e. Affymetrix/Illumina and two-colour data supplied as marray MarrayRaw-objects or limma RGList-objects are available.
